desc.zh-CN: 输出各挂载点使用率（key=value），超 90% 标 WARN

advice.zh-CN: 清理日志/临时文件或扩容；定位大文件：du -xhd1 /，必要时逐层下钻排查
advice.en: Clean logs/temp files or expand; locate large files with du -xhd1 / and drill down

desc.zh-CN: 输出内存使用率与 1/5/15 分钟负载

advice.zh-CN: 排查占用内存/负载的进程：ps aux --sort=-%mem | head；必要时重启或扩容
advice.en: Find top memory/load consumers: ps aux --sort=-%mem | head; restart or scale up

desc.zh-CN: 检查关键 systemd 服务是否 active
desc.en: Check whether key systemd services are active

advice.zh-CN: 查看失败服务并重启：systemctl --failed；journalctl -u <svc> -n 50 查原因
advice.en: Inspect and restart: systemctl --failed; check journalctl -u <svc> -n 50

desc.zh-CN: 基于 /proc/stat 1s 采样计算 CPU 使用率，>=90% 标 WARN
desc.en: CPU usage from /proc/stat (1s sample); WARN at >=90%

advice.zh-CN: 定位高 CPU 进程：top -o %CPU 或 pidstat；确认是否异常循环/流量突增
advice.en: Find hot processes: top -o %CPU or pidstat; check for runaway loops or traffic spikes

desc.zh-CN: 基于 /proc/net/dev 1s 采样，逐网卡 RX/TX 字节/秒（排除 lo）
desc.en: Per-NIC RX/TX bytes/s from /proc/net/dev (1s sample, excluding lo)

advice.zh-CN: 排查异常流量：iftop / ss -s；检查大流量传输或异常连接
advice.en: Investigate traffic: iftop / ss -s; look for bulk transfers or abnormal connections

desc.zh-CN: 基于 /proc/diskstats 1s 采样，逐磁盘 读/写 字节/秒

advice.zh-CN: 定位高 IO 进程：iotop -o；检查备份/日志刷盘或磁盘故障
advice.en: Find heavy I/O: iotop -o; check backups/log flushes or disk issues

desc.zh-CN: 输出系统已运行秒数与空闲秒数

advice.zh-CN: 运行时长偏短说明近期重启；确认异常宕机或计划重启
advice.en: Short uptime suggests a recent reboot; confirm crash vs planned restart

desc.zh-CN: 通用检查：java 进程数量（为 0 FAIL）与总 RSS
desc.en: Generic: java process count (0 => FAIL) and total RSS

advice.zh-CN: 确认 Java 进程缺失/异常：检查应用日志与启动脚本；必要时重启服务
advice.en: Verify the Java process is missing/unhealthy: check app logs and start scripts; restart if needed

desc.zh-CN: 反代节点：判断本机是否持有 VIP（master/backup），并检查 keepalived/nginx 服务；VIP 地址取自 keepalived 配置
desc.en: Reverse-proxy node: detect local VIP holder (master/backup) and check keepalived/nginx; VIP from keepalived config

advice.zh-CN: 确认 VIP 归属是否符合预期；异常时检查 keepalived 状态与主备切换
advice.en: Confirm the VIP holder is expected; if not, check keepalived state and failover

desc.zh-CN: 按进程自动发现本机 redis-server 实例：存活/role/内存占比/命中率/淘汰/阻塞/RDB/主从；密码从常见 conf 路径（含 include）解析经 REDISCLI_AUTH 传入；存活以端口监听判定，INFO 指标可选
desc.en: Auto-discover local redis-server instances: alive/role/mem%/hit-ratio/evicted/blocked/RDB/replication; read requirepass from common conf paths (incl. include) via REDISCLI_AUTH; alive by listening port, INFO metrics optional

advice.zh-CN: 检查 Redis 内存/连接/主从；必要时清理大 key 或扩容，并查看 slowlog
advice.en: Check Redis memory/connections/replication; trim big keys or scale; review slowlog

desc.zh-CN: 只读检查 Docker 容器：运行/重启/健康；重启策略=always 的容器未运行则 FAIL（需目标主机授予只读 sudo docker 权限）
desc.en: Read-only Docker check: up/restarts/health; FAIL if a restart=always container is not running (requires read-only sudo docker on the target host)

advice.zh-CN: 查看异常容器：docker ps -a / docker logs <name>；必要时 docker restart
advice.en: Inspect unhealthy containers: docker ps -a / docker logs <name>; docker restart if needed

desc.zh-CN: 通用主机 Nginx 兜底：进程、80/443 监听、stub_status（不依赖 systemd/nginx CLI）
desc.en: Generic host Nginx fallback: process, 80/443 listen, stub_status (no systemd/nginx CLI)

advice.zh-CN: 检查 Nginx 进程与配置：nginx -t；systemctl status nginx；查看 error.log
advice.en: Check Nginx process and config: nginx -t; systemctl status nginx; review error.log

desc.zh-CN: 非 tmpfs/overlay 文件系统使用率，超 90% FAIL

advice.zh-CN: 清理日志/临时文件或扩容；定位大文件 du -xhd1 /
advice.en: Clean logs/temp files or expand; locate large files with du -xhd1 /

desc.zh-CN: 内存使用率，超 90% FAIL

advice.zh-CN: 排查占用内存的进程；调整缓存/连接数或扩容
advice.en: Find memory consumers; tune caches/connections or scale up

desc.zh-CN: 5m 平均 CPU 使用率，超 90% FAIL

advice.zh-CN: 定位高 CPU 进程；确认是否流量突增或异常任务
advice.en: Find hot processes; check for traffic spikes or runaway jobs

desc.zh-CN: 1 分钟平均负载（仅展示，不设阈值）

advice.zh-CN: 负载持续高于核数说明 CPU 饱和；定位高负载进程或扩容
advice.en: Load persistently above core count means CPU saturation; find the cause or scale

desc.zh-CN: 系统已运行秒数

advice.zh-CN: 运行时长偏短说明近期重启；确认异常宕机或计划重启
advice.en: Short uptime means a recent reboot; confirm crash vs planned restart

desc.zh-CN: 处于 failed 状态的 systemd 单元数，>0 FAIL

advice.zh-CN: 存在失败服务：systemctl --failed 并重启、查 journalctl
advice.en: Failed units present: systemctl --failed, restart and check journalctl

desc.zh-CN: 5m 区间磁盘写入字节/秒（range 示例）

advice.zh-CN: 写入速率异常：iotop -o 定位进程；检查日志/备份刷盘
advice.en: Abnormal write rate: locate with iotop -o; check log/backup flushes

desc.zh-CN: 该实例所有抓取任务存活（任一 job down 即 FAIL）
desc.en: All scrape jobs on the instance up (any job down => FAIL)

advice.zh-CN: 目标不可达：检查 Exporter 进程、网络与防火墙；确认采集端口
advice.en: Target down: check exporter process, network and firewall; verify scrape port

desc.zh-CN: PVE 各节点在线状态

advice.zh-CN: PVE 节点失联：检查节点网络/电源与 pveproxy/pve-cluster 服务
advice.en: PVE node unreachable: check network/power and pveproxy/pve-cluster

desc.zh-CN: PVE 集群在线状态

advice.zh-CN: 集群成员减少：检查节点连通性与 corosync，确认是否掉线
advice.en: Cluster members decreased: check connectivity and corosync; confirm node loss

name.zh-CN: PVE 节点 CPU 使用率

desc.zh-CN: PVE 节点 CPU 使用率，超 90% FAIL

advice.zh-CN: 节点 CPU 高：定位高负载虚拟机/进程，或迁移/扩容
advice.en: High node CPU: find busy VMs/processes; migrate or scale

desc.zh-CN: PVE 节点内存使用率，超 90% FAIL

advice.zh-CN: 节点内存估算含缓存、可能虚高；以 OS(SSH) 为准，必要时回收缓存/扩容
advice.en: Node memory estimate includes cache and may read high; trust OS via SSH; reclaim or expand

desc.zh-CN: PVE 节点根盘使用率，超 90% FAIL
desc.en: PVE node root disk usage; >90% FAIL

advice.zh-CN: 节点根盘占用高：清理日志/旧内核或扩容
advice.en: Node root disk high: clean logs/old kernels or expand

desc.zh-CN: PVE 各存储池使用率，超 90% FAIL

advice.zh-CN: 存储池占用高：清理快照/模板或扩容；确认无异常增长
advice.en: Storage pool high: remove snapshots/templates or expand; check growth

desc.zh-CN: PVE 节点最短运行时长（秒）

advice.zh-CN: 节点近期重启：确认计划升级/维护或异常宕机
advice.en: Node rebooted recently: confirm planned maintenance vs crash

desc.zh-CN: 超过备份周期的虚拟机数量，>0 FAIL
desc.en: VMs past the backup window; >0 FAIL

advice.zh-CN: 存在未备份虚拟机：检查备份任务与存储，补跑备份
advice.en: VMs without backup: check backup jobs/storage and re-run backups

desc.zh-CN: 存在 fence 状态的 HA 资源时 FAIL
desc.en: FAIL when any HA resource is fenced

advice.zh-CN: HA fence 事件：检查节点/存储故障与 HA 日志；确认资源已恢复
advice.en: HA fence event: check node/storage faults and HA logs; verify resources recovered

desc.zh-CN: 订阅 invalid/expired/suspended 时 FAIL（不含 notfound/new）

advice.zh-CN: 订阅过期/不匹配：核对订阅状态并按需续订
advice.en: Subscription expired/mismatched: verify status and renew if needed

desc.zh-CN: 该实例上所有虚拟机/容器 5m 入站速率（B/s，仅展示）
desc.en: 5m inbound rate of all VMs/CTs on the instance (B/s, info)

advice.zh-CN: 入站流量异常：确认业务高峰或异常来源；必要时限流
advice.en: Abnormal inbound traffic: confirm peak load or investigate the source; rate-limit if needed

desc.zh-CN: 该实例上所有虚拟机/容器 5m 出站速率（B/s，仅展示）
desc.en: 5m outbound rate of all VMs/CTs on the instance (B/s, info)

advice.zh-CN: 出站流量异常：排查大流量传输/异常外联；必要时限流
advice.en: Abnormal outbound traffic: check bulk transfers/egress; rate-limit if needed

name.zh-CN: PVE 虚拟机 CPU 使用率

desc.zh-CN: 指定虚拟机 CPU 使用率，超 90% FAIL（需服务器填虚拟化标识）
desc.en: Target VM CPU usage; >90% FAIL (server must set a VM ident)

advice.zh-CN: 虚拟机 CPU 高：登录排查进程或调整 CPU 配额；考虑迁移
advice.en: VM CPU high: log in to check processes or adjust CPU quota; consider migration

name.zh-CN: PVE 虚拟机内存使用率

desc.zh-CN: 指定虚拟机内存使用率，超 90% FAIL

advice.zh-CN: 虚拟机内存高：排查占用进程或调整内存配额；注意 swap
advice.en: VM memory high: find consumers or adjust memory quota; watch swap

name.zh-CN: PVE 虚拟机网络入站速率

desc.zh-CN: 指定虚拟机 5m 入站速率（B/s，仅展示）

advice.zh-CN: 虚拟机入站流量异常：确认业务或排查异常连接
advice.en: VM inbound traffic abnormal: confirm workload or investigate connections

name.zh-CN: PVE 虚拟机网络出站速率

desc.zh-CN: 指定虚拟机 5m 出站速率（B/s，仅展示）

advice.zh-CN: 虚拟机出站流量异常：排查大流量外发/异常外联
advice.en: VM outbound traffic abnormal: check bulk egress/abnormal connections

name.zh-CN: PVE 虚拟机磁盘写入速率

desc.zh-CN: 指定虚拟机 5m 磁盘写入速率（B/s，仅展示）
desc.en: Target VM 5m disk write rate (B/s, info)

advice.zh-CN: 虚拟机写入高：排查日志/任务刷盘或磁盘性能瓶颈
advice.en: VM write high: check log/task flushes or disk bottlenecks

desc.zh-CN: 指定虚拟机运行时长（秒）

advice.zh-CN: 虚拟机近期重启：确认计划内重启或异常重启
advice.en: VM rebooted recently: confirm planned vs unexpected restart

name.zh-CN: PVE 虚拟机 HA 状态

desc.zh-CN: 指定虚拟机 HA 未处于 started 时 FAIL
desc.en: FAIL when the target VM HA is not in started state

advice.zh-CN: VM HA 状态异常：检查 HA 配置与所在节点；确认资源在线
advice.en: VM HA abnormal: check HA config and host node; verify the resource is online

desc.zh-CN: nginx-exporter 在线状态

advice.zh-CN: Nginx 不可达：检查进程/监听端口与配置 nginx -t
advice.en: Nginx down: check process/listen port and nginx -t

desc.zh-CN: Nginx 汇总：up/活跃/读写等待连接/累计请求与连接/QPS/新建连接速率

advice.zh-CN: Nginx 指标异常：结合 QPS/连接数定位上游或限流配置
advice.en: Nginx metrics abnormal: correlate QPS/connections with upstream or limits

desc.zh-CN: Nginx 5m 平均 QPS，超阈值 FAIL（默认 >100，可改）
desc.en: Nginx 5m average QPS; FAIL above threshold (default >100)

advice.zh-CN: QPS 异常：确认业务高峰或上游故障；必要时扩容/限流
advice.en: QPS abnormal: confirm peak or upstream fault; scale or rate-limit

desc.zh-CN: Nginx 5m 新建连接速率，超阈值 FAIL（默认 >100，可改）
desc.en: Nginx 5m new-connection rate; FAIL above threshold (default >100)

advice.zh-CN: 新建连接速率高：检查异常来源或长连接泄漏
advice.en: High new-connection rate: check for abnormal sources or connection leaks

desc.zh-CN: Nginx 当前活跃连接数，超阈值 FAIL（默认 >500，可改）
desc.en: Nginx current active connections; FAIL above threshold (default >500)

advice.zh-CN: 活跃连接数高：检查上游响应变慢或连接堆积；调优超时/扩容
advice.en: High active connections: check slow upstream or backlog; tune timeouts/scale

desc.zh-CN: keepalived-exporter 在线状态

advice.zh-CN: Keepalived 不可达：检查进程与 VRRP 通告（防火墙/多播）
advice.en: Keepalived down: check process and VRRP (firewall/multicast)

desc.zh-CN: 健康检查脚本状态，<1 FAIL

advice.zh-CN: 追踪脚本失败：手动执行该检查脚本并查看 keepalived 日志
advice.en: Track script failures: run the check script manually and inspect keepalived logs

desc.zh-CN: http_status 探活：需把绑定 prom_instance 设为站点 URL（如 https://example.com）
desc.en: http_status probe: set the binding prom_instance to the site URL (e.g. https://example.com)

advice.zh-CN: 站点不可用：检查后端服务、反代与证书/网络
advice.en: Site down: check backend service, proxy and TLS/network

desc.zh-CN: Anubis 代理请求 5m 速率（req/s，仅展示）

advice.zh-CN: 代理请求速率异常：确认业务或排查来源/限流
advice.en: Proxy request rate abnormal: confirm workload or investigate/limit

desc.zh-CN: VictoriaLogs 数据占用/总磁盘，超 90% FAIL

advice.zh-CN: 日志盘占用高：调整保留期/清理旧数据或扩容
advice.en: Log disk high: shorten retention, prune old data or expand

desc.zh-CN: Keepalived 服务/VRRP 状态/健康检查脚本（信息展示，不判定）
desc.en: Info-only: keepalived up / VRRP state / health-check script status

advice.zh-CN: 综合查看 VRRP 状态：确认主备与优先级配置是否符合预期
advice.en: Review VRRP state: verify master/backup and priority as expected

desc.zh-CN: 全集群 MASTER 数量（0 表示 VIP 无人持有），<1 FAIL；建议绑定到 VIP（不依赖 $instance）
desc.en: Cluster MASTER count (0 = VIP not held); <1 FAIL; bind to the VIP (not tied to $instance)

advice.zh-CN: 主备异常：检查优先级/抢占与网络，确认切换是否符合预期
advice.en: Master/backup abnormal: check priority/preempt and network; verify failover
